faqs.q: What do my rates pay for?
faqs.a: The rates and fees you pay can only be reinvested into the operation, maintenance, repair, and replacement needs of that system, nothing else. Here are some examples: Water Service: Treatment and delivery of high-quality drinking water Daily testing and monitoring to meet state and federal safety standards Maintenance of over 600 miles of water pipes Operation of two water treatment facilities Wastewater Service: Collection and removal of wastewater from homes and businesses Treatment through our partnership with Metro Water Recovery Protection of public health and the environment Maintenance of over 450 miles of wastewater pipes Stormwater Service: Management of stormwater runoff from rain and snowmelt Flood protection for homes and businesses Water quality protection for local streams and waterways Maintenance of over 220 miles of storm pipes and open channels Revenue from utility rates is reinvested directly into these systems—not into the City's general fund or other services.
